up: Retrieve molecules reported in document CHEMBL4364343. Return the molecule's ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), max clinical phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Order the results by molecule_chembl_id. Join the docs table (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4364343') to compound_records, then to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to fetch the required fields. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4364343' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
